Marching cubes - Wikipedia
An implementation of the marching cubes algorithm was patented as United States Patent 4,710,876. [2] Another similar algorithm was developed, called marching tetrahedra, in order to circumvent the patent as well as solve a minor ambiguity problem of marching cubes with some cube configurations.
